items.title: Popular sweeteners may leave effects that last for generations

Some of those changes were also detected in later generations that had never consumed the sweeteners themselves.

items.title: A “quantum bath” puts quantum entanglement on autopilot
items.summary_raw: Physicists have demonstrated a new way to entangle distant quantum bits without the constant measurements and active control normally required. The team created a “quantum bath,” a shared environment filled with correlated microwave photons that automatically pushes separated qubits into an entangled state and helps keep them there. The experiment confirms a theoretical prediction made more than 20 years ago and could offer a simpler way to connect modules in future quantum computers.
